Hi Lilly —

Thanks for the list and the questionnaire. We're uploading both the SOC 2 Type II and the signed bridge letter to the Trust Portal now. Timeline: you should receive the portal invite within the hour; bridge letter is already signed and attached here for convenience.

Quick answers to the items you flagged: 
- Data retention: Redwood retains aggregated telemetry per our retention policy; customer data retention is configurable — Rishi has included the retention matrix in his note below.
- Key management: we offer KMS/HSM integrations; see section 4 of the SOC report and the portal evidence for key rotation logs.
- PHI: Redwood can be configured to process PHI in Private deployments under a BAA — for hosted customers we recommend Private deployment or a BAA review. We’ll clarify below.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2026.pdf

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II & Trust Portal Access — Acme Health

Hi Lilly —

I’ve uploaded control evidence for retention, encryption, and key management into the Trust Portal. High-level answers below: 

- Retention: Customer content is retained per contract; default hosted retention is 90 days for unpinned KV cache and 365 days for audit logs unless configured otherwise. We can work with Acme to align retention periods and provide extracts for audit purposes.
- Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256; in transit uses TLS1.3. Key rotation logs and KMS usage are in the portal evidence (see KMS rotation report).
- PHI/BAA: Redwood offers a BAA for customers requiring HIPAA compliance. For hosted deployments we require a BAA and specific contractual controls; for Private deployments (VPC or on-prem) PHI processing is supported with appropriate contractual and technical measures.

Trust Portal link: https://redwood.trustportal.example/invite/ACME-449 (invite sent to Lilly and Tom)

Attachments: trust_portal_invite.url

If you want, we can schedule a 20m call tomorrow morning to walk through the portal artifacts.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
